replacements.originalText: Cursor periodically removes old worktrees to free disk space. Tune how aggressively cleanup runs.
replacements.changeText: Cursor 会定期移除旧工作树以释放磁盘空间。可调整清理强度。
保留的 Cursor 托管工作树上限

replacements.originalText: Maximum number of Cursor-managed worktrees to retain across all workspaces. Older worktrees are removed first.
replacements.changeText: 所有工作区中保留的 Cursor 托管工作树数量上限。优先移除较旧的工作树。

replacements.originalText: Maximum total size in GB across all Cursor-managed worktrees. Set to 0 to disable the size limit.
replacements.changeText: 所有 Cursor 托管工作树的总大小上限（GB）。设为 0 可禁用大小限制。

replacements.originalText: No Cursor-managed worktrees on this machine.
replacements.changeText: 本机暂无 Cursor 托管的工作树。
